So my dad is forced to make dinner at a late hour so he can eat. More recently, he would just eat fast-food before coming home because he doesn't expect dinner to be on the table. So AITA for not cooking dinner today and telling my mom to not expect dinner every time she comes home? Also, my dad ended cooking in the end today.

Being deeply involved in a community, such as a church, can both support and hinder independent thinking. Balancing community engagement with personal reflection and exposure to diverse perspectives can help maintain a healthy, well-rounded perspective.
